allow: Bash(node -e "require\('dotenv'\).config\({path:'./config/config.env'}\); const m=require\('mongoose'\); m.connect\(process.env.DB_URI\).then\(async\(\)=>{ const User=m.connection.db.collection\('users'\); for \(const [u,p] of [['USER_0001','Psw1234'],['USER_0002','Psw123']]\) { const user=await User.findOne\({userId:u}\); const ok = user && user.password===p; console.log\(u, '=>', ok?'LOGIN OK':'FAIL', user?'\(found\)':'\(not found\)'\); } await m.disconnect\(\); process.exit\(0\);}\).catch\(e=>{console.error\('FAIL:',e.message\);process.exit\(1\);}\);")

PowerShell(Write-Output "--- port 5000 listening? ---"; \(Test-NetConnection -ComputerName localhost -Port 5000 -WarningAction SilentlyContinue\).TcpTestSucceeded; Write-Output "--- node processes ---"; Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, StartTime)

PowerShell($conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach \($c in $conns\) { $p = Get-Process -Id $c.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output \("PID {0}  Name {1}  Start {2}" -f $c.OwningProcess, $p.ProcessName, $p.StartTime\) })

PowerShell(Stop-Process -Id 13596 -Force; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 800; Write-Output "stopped; port 5000 now:"; \(Test-NetConnection -ComputerName localhost -Port 5000 -WarningAction SilentlyContinue\).TcpTestSucceeded)

PowerShell(foreach \($a in @\(@{u='USER_0001';p='Psw1234'}, @{u='USER_0002';p='Psw123'}\)\) { try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:5000/api/auth/login' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body \(@{username=$a.u; password=$a.p} | ConvertTo-Json\); Write-Output \("{0} => {1} | role={2} name={3}" -f $a.u, $r.message, $r.user.user_type, $r.user.name\) } catch { Write-Output \("{0} => ERROR {1}" -f $a.u, $_.Exception.Message\) } })
